exposure: Neonatal transportation services attributes (type of transport, equipment, escort training)
outcome: Short-term outcome (poor condition on arrival, critical condition on arrival)
cohort: The study included neonates referred from primary health care facilities across rural Tanzania to Iringa Regional Referral hospital, whose parents or caregivers provided written consent.
finding: Neonates who traveled for over 30 minutes were six times more likely to arrive in critical condition compared to those who used less time.
